Hi. Im Mike Harmon and I am running for Secretary of State of the Commonwealth of Kentucky.

rows.source: Hi. Im Mike Harmon and I am running for Secretary of State of the Commonwealth of Kentucky.

audio.text: I proudly served the people of the Commonwealth as the taxpayers’ watchdog in Frankfort during my time as state auditor uncovering waste, fraud and abuse.

rows.source: I proudly served the people of the Commonwealth as the taxpayers’ watchdog in Frankfort during my time as state auditor uncovering waste, fraud and abuse.

audio.text: Before that, I served in the state house fighting to protect your religious freedoms, for smaller government, for Pro-Life, Pro-Family, and Pro 2nd Amendment policies.

rows.source: Before that, I served in the state house fighting to protect your religious freedoms, for smaller government, for Pro-Life, Pro-Family, and Pro 2nd Amendment policies. (heightened speed on delivery but slow down for next line)

audio.text: I am the only candidate seeking the Republican nomination who has a proven conservative track record.

rows.source: I am the only candidate seeking the Republican nomination who has a proven conservative track record.

audio.text: You trusted me with protecting your taxpayer dollars, now I’m asking you to trust me again to protect the integrity of your vote.

rows.source: You trusted me with protecting your taxpayer dollars, now I’m asking you to trust me again to protect the integrity of your vote.

audio.text: I humbly ask that next May, you vote for me so I can go back to working for you by following the data and demanding our elections are safe and secure. Thank you and God bless.

audio.text: I'm Gex Williams, and it's an honor to represent Kentucky's 20th Senate District.

rows.source: I'm Gex Williams, and it's an honor to represent Kentucky's 20th Senate District.

audio.text: I'm a businessman who decided to head to Frankfort because I was sick and tired of watching politicians wasting taxpayer dollars.

rows.source: I'm a businessman who decided to head to Frankfort because I was sick and tired of watching politicians wasting taxpayer dollars.

audio.text: Since being elected, I've stood up to special interests and fought against tax increases being proposed to prop up big government.

audio.text: But my works not done. Frankfort still needs to be reformed and there is always a federal regulation to push back against.

audio.text: That's why I humbly ask that you send me back to Frankfort. I will never stop fighting for you and your families and I hope to earn your vote on or before November third.
